+title: Remove plan.md references from the tests and delete plan.md
+---
+## What
+`plan.md` is the original extraction plan. The user wants it removed because the work that it describes is complete. The Router design that it gives is also stale. This task removes the last references to it, which are in the test comments, and then deletes the file. It is a comment-only change in the tests: no assertion, no test name, and no behavior changes.
+
+Files and reference counts (`rg -c "plan\.md" Tests IntegrationTests`):
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsRankerTests/BM25Tests.swift` (6)
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsRankerTests/SearcherTests.swift` (4)
+- 2 each: `RankerTests.swift`, `LanguageModelSessionSupportTests.swift`, `HybridRankerTests.swift`, `ExamplesSmokeTests.swift`, `CosineScoringTests.swift`
+- 1 each: `TrigramTests.swift`, `Support/ScriptedAgentSession.swift`, `Support/FixtureSelectionCatalog.swift`, `Support/FakeEmbedder.swift`, `SelectionTests.swift`, `SelectionCoreTests.swift`, `SelectionConfigTests.swift`, `RRFTests.swift`, `RankedDocumentTests.swift`, `PackageTests.swift`, `EmbeddingSeamTests.swift`
+- Also check `IntegrationTests/` and `README.md` with the same `rg`, and fix any reference that it finds.
+
+Rule for each reference:
+- If the comment only points to the plan (for example "(plan.md §5)"), remove the pointer.
+- If the comment uses the plan as the reason for a test (for example `BM25Tests.fieldWeightConstantsMatchPlanSpec`, "plan.md §4.1's ×5 primary-field / ×1 body-field weighting"), write the reason in the comment itself. Keep the test name as it is, so that no test changes. If the name must change because it refers to a deleted file, change only the name.
+- Keep lineage notes (for example "Ported from CodeContextKit's ..."). Remove only the plan.md part.
+
+Then delete `plan.md` at the repository root with `git rm plan.md`.
+
+Do not add a test for this. The user does not want guard tests.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `plan.md` does not exist at the repository root.
+- [ ] `rg -n "plan\.md" --glob '!.kanban/**' .` gives no match in tracked source, test, manifest, or README files.
+- [ ] In the test files, only comment lines change, with the one permitted exception of a test name that refers to the plan.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes at the repository root.
+- [ ] `swift build --package-path IntegrationTests --build-tests` passes. (Do not run the real-model tests. They need Apple Intelligence.)
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] No new test. This is a comment-only change and a file deletion.
+- [ ] Run `rg -n "plan\.md" --glob '!.kanban/**' .`. Expected result: no match.
+- [ ] Run `swift test`. Expected result: the full hermetic suite passes, with the same test count as before.
+- [ ] Run `swift build --package-path IntegrationTests --build-tests`. Expected result: the build passes.
\ No newline at end of file
